sections.title: I. Lento doloroso – Solitary Recitation (M. 1–4)
sections.character: Solitary funeral bell, deep silence, and weeping Bel Canto sighs

sections.title: II. Moderato con affetto – The Weeping Cantilena (M. 5–24)
sections.character: Chopin-style singing cantilena, chromatic lament bass, and Neapolitan sighs

sections.title: III. Poco più mosso – The Romantic Dream in Eb Major (M. 25–64)
sections.character: Liszt three-hand texture: soaring melody wrapped in rippling crystalline arpeggios

sections.title: IV. Allegro tempestoso e crescendo – The Gathering Storm (M. 65–100)
sections.character: Urgent syncopated chords over rising chromatic bass octaves

sections.title: V. Cadenza precipitosa & The Cliff-Edge Cutoff (M. 101–108)
sections.character: Harrowing 4-octave chromatic descent slamming into an abrupt dead-stop cliff-edge silence

sections.title: VI. Presto con fuoco – The Zimerman 7:40 Coda Drop-Off (M. 109–156)
sections.character: The Zimerman 7:40 drop-off: whispered sotto voce terror, sweeping ostinato, and 36-bar volcanic crescendo

sections.title: VII. Apoteosi Tragica & Stretta (M. 157–180)
sections.character: Crashing double octaves, catastrophic German sixth, and unyielding tragic minor resolution

annotations.title: Solitary Recitation & Bel Canto Sighs
annotations.instruction: Allow the low G bell to ring with deep chest resonance. Let the right-hand sighing motif (D5-C#5-E5-D5) breathe with tender rubato hesitation.

annotations.title: The Chromatic Lament Bass & Neapolitan Pang
annotations.instruction: Shape the chromatic descent in the bass (G -> F# -> F -> E -> Eb -> D). Lean into the Neapolitan Ab Major harmony at bar 9 with deep singing touch.

annotations.title: The Liszt Three-Hand Barcarolle in Eb Major
annotations.instruction: Gentle 12/8 rocking motion. Project the singing melody warmly while keeping the surrounding 8th-note broken chords soft and crystalline.

pedalGuidance.explanation: Deep sympathetic bloom on downbeats with clean half-pedal clears on chord changes.

annotations.title: The 7:35 Cliff-Edge Cutoff & Dead Silence
annotations.instruction: Hurl total body weight into the four-octave chromatic descent. On the final downbeat of bar 108, kill the pedal INSTANTLY. Absolute dead silence.

annotations.title: The 7:40 Coda Drop-Off: Sotto Voce Agitato
annotations.germanTerm: Presto con Fuoco: Sotto Voce Eröffnung
annotations.instruction: Snap into 156 BPM in icy, whispered pianissimo. The left hand leaps with mechanical precision, while the right hand gasps on off-beats. Let the crescendo build with terrifying patience.

pedalGuidance.explanation: Quarter-pedal syncopated taps on downbeats for electric crispness without muddiness.

annotations.title: Apoteosi Tragica: The Final Apocalypse
annotations.instruction: Unleash full orchestral power (fff). Engage back and shoulder muscles for the crashing octaves. Hold the final low G1-G2 octave under full pedal until silence.
